Question: I usually have dreams in which either I get married or my sister gets married, or we both get married,or someone comes to see us. Please give a nice tabir my parents are waiting to get both of us married soon before Ramadan inshallah. Answer ID: 12556 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1101/850=H/1430) It is nice dream. It means that the marriage proposed and solemnized by parents shall have more blessings and barakah.
